summary: Implemented the Tabs feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run and nothing was committed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and now yields one Text with click spans appended last; Opacity merges blended color into the existing style so metadata survives; tests added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (required two-range test plus a zero-width test) and tests/test_tabs.py; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css. Deviations/choices: bar position uses a displayed-index helper so duplicate names place the underline under the displayed tab (find_tab_by_name is still used for navigation); Tabs sets can_focus=True; letter search skips tabs whose name equals the active name; the layout resolver already had size/min_size/fraction defaults so it was left unchanged; the demo does not focus the widget. All tests are unverified because they were not executed.
